Sub: Audio Recording of Conference Call on the Un-audited Financial Results for the second quarter 
ended September 30, 2026. 
 
Dear Sir/ Ma’am, 
 
In continuation to our Letter dated October 21, 2026, and pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Part A Para A 
of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we would like to inform that the Audio Recording of the Conference Call 
held on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 12 Noon. (IST) for discussing the financial performance of the 
Company for the second quarter ended September 30, 2026 is available on the website of the Company at 
https://www.radiocity.in/investors/other-compliance-recordings. 
 
The transcript for the said call will be shared with the Stock Exchanges and uploaded on the Company’s 
website (www.radiocity.in) in due course. 
 
You are requested to kindly take this on record. 
 
Yours Faithfully
